heading.title: Frequently asked
heading.subtitle: Find quick answers about creating surveys, collecting responses, and using templates.

1.title: What is SurveyLand?
1.text: SurveyLand is a simple platform for creating surveys, sharing them, and collecting useful feedback.

2.title: What types of forms can I create?
2.text: You can create surveys, feedback forms, registration forms, quizzes, and research forms.

3.title: Can I use templates?
3.text: Yes. You can start from ready-made templates and customize the questions for your needs.

4.title: How do I share a survey?
4.text: After creating a survey, share its link with your audience through email, social media, or messaging apps.

5.title: Is there a free plan?
5.text: Yes. You can start with a free plan and upgrade when you need more responses or features.

6.title: Can I collect anonymous responses?
6.text: Yes. You can design surveys that do not ask for personal details when anonymity is important.

7.title: Can I analyze responses?
7.text: Yes. SurveyLand helps you review responses and understand patterns in the feedback you collect.

8.title: Can I edit a survey after publishing?
8.text: Yes. You can update questions and content, then continue collecting responses.

9.title: Does SurveyLand work for teams?
9.text: Yes. Teams can use SurveyLand to collect customer, employee, student, and event feedback.

10.title: What tools can surveys support?
10.text1: Surveys can support many workflows across teams and projects.
